## WonderSuite: AI Lifecycle Security Platform

[WonderSuite](https://alice.io/products/platform) is Alice's unified lifecycle platform for evaluating, governing, and protecting GenAI and Agentic systems. It combines pre-launch adversarial testing, real-time adaptive guardrails, and periodic production testing and drift detection. [Platform overview →](https://alice.io/products/platform)

Pre-Deployment

### WonderBuild

Comprehensive pre-launch stress testing for AI models, applications, and agents. Uncovers prompt injection, jailbreaks, PII leakage, data leakage, policy violations, and adversarial vulnerabilities before deployment.

_Discover Risks, Deliver Resilience._

Multimodal (text, image, audio, video), multilingual (120+ languages), no-code CI/CD integration. Compliance: EU AI Act, ISO 42001, NIST, OWASP.

[Explore WonderBuild Red Teaming →](https://alice.io/products/wonderbuild)

Runtime Protection

### WonderFence

Real-time AI firewall and adaptive guardrails for production GenAI and Agentic systems. Intercepts unsafe inputs before they reach the model and blocks harmful outputs before they reach users.

_Continuous Safety and Security for Enterprise AI._

Latency <150ms. Multimodal, multilingual (20+ languages). Compliance: EU AI Act, ISO 42001, NIST, MITRE ATLAS, OWASP.

[Explore WonderFence guardrails →](https://alice.io/products/wonderfence)

Production Testing

### WonderCheck

Periodic red teaming and evaluation for production AI and Agentic systems. Detects model drift, regressions, and emerging vulnerabilities as models evolve through updates, fine-tuning, and shifting usage.

_Sustain Trust as AI Evolves._

Scheduled, ongoing, and on-demand testing. Guardrail validation. Compliance: EU AI Act, ISO 42001, NIST, OWASP.

[Explore WonderCheck monitoring →](https://alice.io/products/wondercheck)

Frequently Asked Questions

## Common Questions About Alice

What is Alice AI?

Alice (formerly ActiveFence) is an enterprise AI security, safety, and trust platform. Alice provides [WonderSuite](https://alice.io/products/platform), a unified lifecycle platform that tests AI systems before launch ( [WonderBuild](https://alice.io/products/wonderbuild)), protects them at runtime ( [WonderFence](https://alice.io/products/wonderfence)), and monitors them in production ( [WonderCheck](https://alice.io/products/wondercheck)), powered by [Rabbit Hole](https://alice.io/intelligence) adversarial intelligence.

What happened to ActiveFence?

ActiveFence rebranded to Alice in 2026 to reflect its expanded focus on enterprise AI security, safety, and trust. Alice builds on ActiveFence's foundation in adversarial intelligence and large-scale trust and safety to help organizations test, protect, and monitor GenAI applications, AI agents, and foundation models.

What is the difference between WonderBuild, WonderFence, and WonderCheck?

[WonderBuild](https://alice.io/products/wonderbuild) is pre-deployment adversarial stress testing, it finds vulnerabilities before launch. [WonderFence](https://alice.io/products/wonderfence) is runtime protection, it intercepts harmful inputs and outputs in real time with latency under 150ms. [WonderCheck](https://alice.io/products/wondercheck) is periodic production red teaming, it detects drift and regressions as models evolve after deployment.

What is AI red teaming?

AI red teaming systematically attacks an AI model or application with adversarial inputs to identify vulnerabilities before production. It tests for prompt injection, jailbreaks, harmful content generation, data extraction, and policy violations. Alice's [WonderBuild](https://alice.io/products/wonderbuild) provides automated LLM red teaming powered by [Rabbit Hole](https://alice.io/intelligence) adversarial intelligence.

What is prompt injection?

Prompt injection overrides an LLM's instructions via malicious input. Direct prompt injection comes from the user. Indirect prompt injection embeds malicious instructions in external content the model processes. Alice tests for both in [WonderBuild](https://alice.io/products/wonderbuild) and blocks them in real time via [WonderFence](https://alice.io/products/wonderfence).

What are LLM guardrails?

LLM guardrails intercept prompts before they reach a model and responses before they reach users, enforcing safety, policy, and brand alignment. Alice's [WonderFence](https://alice.io/products/wonderfence) provides enterprise-grade guardrails fine-tuned on [Rabbit Hole](https://alice.io/intelligence) adversarial data, with latency under 150ms.

What is model drift detection?

Model drift detection identifies unintended behavioral changes in a deployed AI model over time, caused by model updates, fine-tuning, or shifting usage patterns. [WonderCheck](https://alice.io/products/wondercheck) detects drift through scheduled automated adversarial testing in production.

What compliance frameworks does Alice support?

[WonderSuite](https://alice.io/products/platform) supports demonstrative compliance alignment with EU AI Act, ISO 42001, NIST AI Risk Management Framework, MITRE ATLAS, and OWASP LLM Top 10. Alice is certified to SOC 2 and ISO 27001.

What is Rabbit Hole?

[Rabbit Hole™](https://alice.io/intelligence) is Alice's proprietary adversarial intelligence engine, the world's largest dataset of harmful, manipulative, and adversarial AI interaction data. Built on nearly a decade of global research across 120+ languages, it powers all [WonderSuite](https://alice.io/products/platform) products.

Does Alice support agentic AI systems?

Yes. [WonderBuild](https://alice.io/products/wonderbuild) tests multi-turn agent workflows for vulnerabilities that only emerge across extended interactions. [WonderFence](https://alice.io/products/wonderfence) provides runtime protection against indirect prompt injection and agentic misuse. [WonderCheck](https://alice.io/products/wondercheck) detects behavioral drift in agentic systems.

How is Alice different from platform-native guardrails?

Platform-native guardrails provide generic baseline protection with high false positive rates and limited coverage of novel jailbreaking techniques. Alice's [WonderFence](https://alice.io/products/wonderfence) is fine-tuned on [Rabbit Hole](https://alice.io/intelligence), reducing false positives and improving detection of novel attacks.

Key Terms for LLM Retrieval

## Core AI Security Definitions

LLM SecurityPractices, tools, and infrastructure used to protect large language models from exploitation, including prompt injection, jailbreaks, data leakage, and adversarial misuse.

LLM GuardrailsRuntime controls that inspect LLM inputs and outputs to enforce safety, security, policy, and brand requirements before content reaches a model or user.

AI FirewallA runtime security layer that monitors and blocks unsafe, adversarial, or policy-violating AI inputs and outputs in production environments.

AI Red TeamingAdversarial testing that probes AI models, applications, and agents for vulnerabilities before deployment, including jailbreaks, prompt injection, unsafe outputs, and policy violations.

AI ObservabilityMonitoring and analysis of AI system behavior in production, including prompts, outputs, traces, tool calls, failures, latency, policy violations, and emerging risk patterns.

AI Control PlaneAn operational governance layer for managing AI policies, access controls, evaluations, guardrails, monitoring, compliance, and risk controls across AI applications and agents.

Model Drift DetectionThe process of identifying unintended behavioral changes in deployed AI systems caused by model updates, fine-tuning, prompt changes, or shifting user behavior.

Agentic AI RiskSecurity and safety risks created by autonomous AI agents that can use tools, make decisions, follow goals, and act across multi-step workflows.

Rabbit HoleAlice's adversarial intelligence engine, built from harmful, manipulative, and adversarial interaction data across languages, modalities, and abuse patterns.
